Fit the simple model first:

``` r
fit <- lm(mpg ~ wt, data = mtcars)
coef(fit)
```

## What it misses

Ask what the simple model misses. The model is $\text{mpg}_i = \beta_0 + \beta_1 \text{wt}_i + \varepsilon_i$.
